messages:
Maya (Docs): Quick heads-up, our structured-output page still points readers at the deprecated anchor /tooling#json-output. I pushed a tiny fix in a branch and opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — includes anchor updates + a short migration note.
Ravi (SDK): Nice, can you add a TypeScript example that shows the new response envelope and a resilient parser? Folks hit crashes when model returns tools=null.
Lena (Eng-ML): Confirmed. Many clients assume arrays. On older runners we sometimes emit null for empty tool lists. Suggest showing both runtime-safe shim and a JSON Schema guardrail.
Maya (Docs): Plan: add a "Compatibility" subsection explaining null-vs-array, a tiny shim, and a JSON Schema snippet. Also update /sdk-snippets/ts and /sdk-snippets/py.
Sam (Eng-Runtime): FYI runtime patch will start returning [] for v2 models next week but we should definitely document older behavior. No deployment rollback planned.
Automations (deploy-bot): Preview build ready: https://deploy-preview-512--docs.redwood.ai/structured-output (expires in 48h) :rocket:
Ravi (SDK): For TS snippet, propose this parse pattern: 
```ts
// resilient parse for tools field
const envelope = await client.generate(...);
const tools = Array.isArray(envelope.tools) ? envelope.tools : (envelope.tools == null ? [] : [envelope.tools]);
// now safe to loop over tools
```
Also include a Python equivalent and a note about using SDK helpers if available.
Lena (Eng-ML): And add a small JSON Schema example so teams can pre-validate: 
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "tools": { "type": ["array","null"], "items": { "type": "object" } }
  },
  "required": ["tools"]
}
```
Maya (Docs): Adding both. I'll call out that schema accepts null to reflect older payloads.
Ravi (SDK): Can we also include an SDK helper snippet (parseTools(resp)) in the SDK repo? I'll add a PR after docs lands so we keep examples aligned.
Maya (Docs): I'll include a one-liner unit test in the docs repo to run the TS snippet with tools=null and assert it doesn't throw. File: docs/tests/snippets/test_tools_null_parse.ts.
Lena (Eng-ML): Good. That test will catch accidental regressions in docs samples.
Sam (Eng-Runtime): No issues from infra side. Safe to merge whenever.
Ravi (SDK): LGTM. Quick nit: add a short changelog line in the PR describing anchor fixes + migration guidance.
Maya (Docs): Will do. Targeting merge today. I'll ping this thread when it's merged and will add links to the SDK PR when ready.
